header_sentences: See Nostril, and see Odour, and Smell.

contexts.text: The ornament of gold () was placed upon the nose, as is evident from... ; for the reason that the nose signified the life of good, from the respiration which is there, which, in the internal sense, is life; and also from the odour, which is what is grateful of love...
To remove the nose and the ears () = to remove the perception of truth and good, and the obedience of faith.
The upper part of his nose appeared filthily furrowed...
Hence it is that by the nose, when predicated of the Lord, is also signified wrath; thus the punishment, vastation, and damnation of those who are in evils and falsities. Illustrated. AE 741:22.
(In the Second Earth) their eyes and nose are small, (which) with them is a beauty.
(In the Fifth Earth) with the men, the nose is more snowy than fleshy in colour.
The head (with those who have confirmed themselves against the Divine and in favour of nature) appears callous, as if of ebony, even to the nose; a sign that they no longer have any perception.

The natural man who has been made sensuous through evils and the derivative falsities, in the light of Heaven appears... with nose retracted. The reason the nose is drawn in, is that the nose corresponds to the perception of truth.

In the Spiritual World it is said of (these sensuous ones) that, as they confirm themselves, so do they close up the interiors of their minds, even to the nose at last; for the nose = the perception of truth...

Such do they become who in the world do not believe that there is anything of Divine Providence, and who explore nothing with others than their cupidities and desires, and thus lead them until they dominate over them... Seen in the light of Heaven, they appear without a nose... They are more sensuous than all others.

The understanding, when closed up by religion... has nothing in it but thick darkness, (which)... establishes a barrier against all spiritual light in the Corporeal Sensuous, far below the Rational... that is, puts it close to the nose, and fixes it in the cartilage of it; owing to which it cannot afterwards have even a scent of spiritual things... By scent I mean perception.
These serious Spirits were said to act into the interior left part of the nose; for on the septum of the nose, as an axis, the rest of the things of the face depend, as circumferences.
His nose was rather sharp, and had so decreased with age that scarcely any nose remained, only some of the tip.
Therefore they have no nose, and some of them but little of a nose; for they cannot have perception.
The upper part of his nose was seen to be filthily furrowed with a filthy wound...
A nose-jewel upon the nose () = the perception of good.

A hook in his nose () = that he will be stupid and silly; for the nose = perception, and a hook the extraction of it; properly, immersion in the Corporeal Sensuous, which, separated from the Rational, is stupid.

Lastly, the natural mind is closed, even to the sensuous mind, which is expressed in Heaven by its being said. Even to the nose; and thus they become merely sensuous, who are the most stupid of all in spiritual things...
